name: cml-driver-eye-mask
description: DR-0013 row 6 (combined swing+jitter passing-eye criterion) for one lane of the CML output driver (design/cml_driver.sch), against the DR-0002 load, swept over pad capacitance 0/1/2 pF in-deck, at both spec/tmds-tx.md #1 operating points, across the full PVT matrix. Drives a genuine PRBS7 (period 127) pattern -- long enough to develop real ISI, unlike sim/cml-driver-eye's fixed 16-bit pattern -- tiles each UI into 8 phase bins, and grades whether a 200 mV x 0.75 UI eye-mask box fits anywhere in the resulting open eye.
claim: spec/decisions/0013-operating-conditions.md#row-6 -- eye height >= 200 mV AND eye width >= 0.75 UI, measured simultaneously at the eye's widest opening, no fixed sampling instant assumed, at both spec/tmds-tx.md #1 operating points (742.5 Mbps/lane target, 270 Mbps/lane fallback).

transient.pattern: prbs7 (ITU-T O.150, x^7+x^6+1, all-ones seed, period 127), preceded by a 20-bit rolling-history prefix (the sequence's own tail) so the measured period starts fully settled; 150 bits driven, 127 measured -- see sim/cml-driver-eye-mask/gen_testbench.py

measure.ui_ref: TRIG v(inref) VAL=0 FALL=1 TARG v(inref) VAL=0 RISE=1

ui_ref.description: Harness-integrity check, not a design claim: the measured unit interval must differ across the rate grid, confirming rate_val actually reached the stimulus (same convention as sim/cml-driver-eye).

eyemask_margin_c0.description: DR-0013 row 6 (spec/decisions/0013-operating-conditions.md): does a 200 mV x 0.75 UI box fit somewhere in the open eye, 0 pF pad. Scanned over every 6-of-8-bin window position (no fixed sampling instant assumed); PASS iff the best achievable per-window minimum vertical opening is >= 0.2 V.
